title: Clicking one of several picked layers narrows the selection to it
goal: With three boxes picked, clicking one of them to work on just that one does nothing: all three stay picked. You have to click empty canvas first and then click the box. Every other app on the Mac narrows the selection to the thing you clicked, and Photonz should too.
notes: Found 2026-09-04 while verifying the colour-section task. CanvasView.mouseDown (around Sources/Photonz/CanvasView.swift:1780) deliberately swallows a press on a member of a multi-selection so the group can travel with the pointer, and starts a MultiMoveDrag. The mouseUp branch for multiMove (around :2251) commits a move when liveOrigins is non-nil and otherwise does nothing, so a press that never moved leaves the selection untouched. The fix is the standard press-keeps/click-narrows split: in that mouseUp branch, when the drag never moved, select the layer that was pressed. Reproduced with Scripts/playtest/multi-style-walk.json before it was taught to deselect first: its stage 4 unlinked the style from all three boxes instead of the one it had clicked.
acceptance: With several layers picked, clicking one of them and letting go without moving leaves only that layer picked
Pressing on one of several picked layers and dragging still moves the whole selection, as it does today
Shift-clicking a picked layer still drops it from the selection rather than narrowing to it
A playtest walk proves the click narrows, and the drag does not

log.note: Adversarial review before building: the mock is not involved, this is a platform convention. Checked what could break — shift-click drops a member and returns on the press, so it never reaches this path; Escape mid-drag still means never mind and does not narrow; the canvas has no right-click menu, so a context menu on a multi-selection cannot be affected; a 2 point jitter is a click by the same 4 point tolerance single layers use. Shortest version: remember which layer the press landed on, and narrow to it on release when the drag never moved.

TDD: added PickedMemberPress to PhotonzCore (Sources/PhotonzCore/MultiLayerDrag.swift) with tests in Tests/PhotonzCoreTests/MultiLayerDragTests.swift, red first, then green. CanvasView.MultiMoveDrag now carries the pick (id + group context); the mouseUp multiMove branch narrows via onSelectLayerInGroup when the drag never moved, and sets selectedLayerFrame first so the handles land in the same beat.

Proved on the probe app with Scripts/playtest/click-narrows-walk.json: three picked, click the middle -> selection ['Rectangle 2'] and no frame moved; three picked, drag from the middle -> all three moved by 60,40 and all three still picked; shift-click a picked one -> drops it; a 2 point press -> narrows and nothing moved.

Scripts/playtest/multi-drag-walk.json stage 6 asserted the old behavior (a tiny press keeps both picked). Rewrote its note to the new rule and re-picked both rectangles before stage 7, which depended on stage 6 leaving the pair selected. Reran that walk: stages 7, 8, 9 all still hold.
Scripts/test.sh green (2756 tests). Audit at queue/audits/2026-09-04-click-narrows.json with two real window captures (Screen Recording granted).

Clicking one of several picked layers now narrows to it. PickedMemberPress in PhotonzCore (tested) plus the pick carried through CanvasView's multi-move drag; press-and-drag still moves the group, shift-click still drops. Verified with Scripts/playtest/click-narrows-walk.json on the probe app and Scripts/test.sh green (2756). Audit: queue/audits/2026-09-04-click-narrows.json
